reviewMeaning: Normalization and controlled-CI successor consistency pass; not adoption, package, publication, or release qualification.

checks.name: subject and member binding
checks.evidence: subject-v13 matched its assigned identity; all 19 member hashes and sizes matched current files.

checks.name: V12 distribution delta
checks.evidence: V12 and V13 contain the same 19 paths. Only .github/workflows/harness-premerge.yml and export-manifest.csv changed; export-report.md and the other 16 members remain byte-identical. Exact-member git diff --check passed.

checks.name: corrected normalization freeze
checks.evidence: V13 binds corrected NORMALIZATION_FREEZE_V1.json at 2ade5f523b75d812132c64772ba4edaa1803f6dac90e5c396aed10dcdfaf286b, not superseded de7325d5; overlay matched 443093a6f58d23f461975481674fd1316213a22d7ff535c29cce10efe57b1fd4.

checks.name: normalization overlay integrity
checks.evidence: All 27 current postimages matched overlay newSizeBytes/newSha256 values; corrected freeze and overlay postimage maps matched exactly; every entry records canonicalTextUnchanged=true.

checks.name: normalized public closure
checks.evidence: All 11 normalized paths included in public export matched canonical source, stage, CSV size/hash, and overlay postimage identities exactly. These comprise nine bundled skill/reference files and two governed docs.

checks.name: workflow index
checks.evidence: Canonical workflows/index.json remains byte-identical at SHA-256 1f34a12e0db95467c7c7a3500ff7301a1fd8aa30e01ab4dc4c789656ab12d9b7 with 79 methods. Public stage has 78 after the intended chirality-change exclusion.

checks.name: bundle closure
checks.evidence: Independent temp-only preparation produced 366 manifest files and exactly seven intended skills; chirality-change remained excluded.

checks.name: stage and manifest
checks.evidence: All 1104 unique CSV rows exactly matched current stage paths, sizes, and SHA-256 values; stage has zero symlinks and special entries, zero boundary findings, and no private/excluded/App frontend source.

checks.name: report truthfulness
checks.evidence: Unchanged report row, sanitization, boundary, and top-level counts exactly match current stage and manifest.

checks.name: CI worker successor
checks.evidence: Harness Premerge Runtime test command adds --maxWorkers=1; SERIAL_TEST.log matched b2f27f9420db94eaa8b57098de2ec09971c1a5456c2350d148168e41eb4f6d08 and reports 53 test files passed, 1 skipped, 772 tests passed, and 14 skipped.

checks.name: semantic contract preservation
checks.evidence: Independent focused runs passed 57/57 contract-pin, packaged-security, and DMG-policy checks plus 10/10 preparation and integrity checks. Contract pins and D121 identity members remain byte-identical.

checks.name: source and prior review anchors
checks.evidence: Root/App/Runtime V6 anchors and terminal Runtime evidence remain exact. V13 predecessor and priorIndependentReview identities match subject-v12, RETURN.md, CHECKS.json, and MANIFEST.json; V12 manifest internal bindings reverified.

checks.name: holds and qualification
checks.evidence: KG-001 remains needs_remediation; stage ADOPTION_HOLD remains HELD; adoption/release holds and source-and-controlled-checks-only qualification are explicit; native/package/distribution/publication/release qualification is disclaimed.

limitations: This review validates the frozen normalization, distribution, and controlled-CI evidence. It does not establish adoption acceptance, native packaging, supplier/account/credential readiness, publication, distribution, or release qualification.
